General Conditions

The prices displayed may vary and should serve as a guide for your selected journey. The prices apply to round or one way trips according to your selection. The end price is subject to change depending on the selected payment option. Seats are limited and may not be available on all days/flights. The fare might only be available during a special travel time and might not be available during holidays or other peak seasons. Fares include applicable fees, taxes and airport charges. Baggage might not be included in the end price. Additional baggage fees may apply. The fare might not be refundable or changeable. Minimum stay/maximum stay and/or advanced purchase might apply.

Passengers are entitled to one piece of winter sports equipment free of charge in addition to their standard baggage allowance on all eligible fares (excluding Basic and Light fares). Applicable on SWISS marketed and operated flights. Codeshare flights are excluded. Winter sports equipment consist of: One pair of skis or one snowboard. One bag containing one pair of ski poles and one pair of ski or snowboard boots. One helmet. Maximum permitted dimension: 200 cm length. Also please ensure that your sports baggage and special baggage is registered as early as possible, and in any case no later than 72 hours before departure.

Transport of sports equipment is subject to available cargo hold capacity. Carriage cannot be guaranteed in all cases and depends on the respective load situation of the flight.
